artifact_observations.location: Ring connection points and background transition
artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal rings lack clear mechanical attachment points to a base plate. They appear to float or merge ambiguously into the blurred background. The geometry of the rings themselves shows slight inconsistencies in thickness and continuity, typical of AI generation struggling with precise mechanical hardware.
The texture on the blue surface appears slightly 'painted' or smudged rather than having the distinct grain of vinyl or plastic. It lacks realistic micro-details even considering the blur.

The perspective of the rings shifts inconsistently. While they follow a curve, the individual ring shapes do not align perfectly with a single vanishing point or camera axis, creating a subtle sense of spatial warping.

To assess the realism of the lighting, reflections on the metal, and the quality of the bokeh effect.

Determine if this constitutes a major structural failure or an acceptable artistic abstraction. Evaluate if the blur is natural optical bokeh or AI-generated smearing.
